one_liner: Customer service platform with messaging, help center, and a robust REST API.
auth_notes: Once you have a token, simply provide it as an Authorization:Bearer header in your requests.
verdict_reason: Intercom offers a fully documented REST API supporting OAuth2 and Bearer token authentication, which can be accessed via self-serve developer accounts.

evidence.quote: Our REST API is a core building block of the Intercom Platform. You can use it to retrieve and update information from your own Intercom account, or to integrate Intercom into your own product.

To access the Intercom API, you have two authentication options depending on whether you app is public or private.
OAuth is for if you're building a public app that accesses other people's Intercom data.
